title: Novel Silicon-Based Fluorescent Nanocomposite Drug Carriers for Natural Compound Delivery in Melanoma Treatment.
authors: Gao, Fei; Li, Lei; Liu, Linbo; Li, Guangshuai; Zhang, Jianan; Zhan, Wang; You, Wenjian; Lin, Xia; Liu, Yun; Wang, Jiayao; Chen, Denglin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究硅基荧光纳米复合药物载体递送白藜芦醇治疗黑色素瘤，仅涉及小分子-配位聚合物对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Melanoma, a highly aggressive cancer, is closely associated with an elevated tumor mutation burden (TMB) and an active tumor microenvironment (TME). Melanin synthesis, a key feature of melanoma progression, is primarily regulated by tyrosinase (TYR), the rate-limiting enzyme controlled by the microphthalmia-associated transcription factor (MITF). Resveratrol (Res), a natural polyphenol known for its antioxidant and anticancer properties, faces limitations including poor solubility, low bioavailability, and rapid metabolism. To overcome these challenges, a three-dimensional Co(II) coordination polymer [Co(bpdado)(bpe)(H(2)O)(2)].2DMF.2 H(2)On (1) was synthesized and incorporated into a composite material, 1@CP1, for Res delivery (1@CP1@Res). The system exhibited enhanced solubility, pH-sensitive release, and improved biological activity. Fluorescence assays demonstrated significant quenching in the presence of Cu(2)(+) ions, indicating a high sensitivity of 1@CP1@Res to metal ion interactions. The pH-responsive drug release profile was confirmed by in vitro studies showing accelerated release at lower pH values, mimicking the acidic tumor microenvironment. Cell viability assays revealed that 1@CP1@Res significantly inhibited the proliferation of murine B16-F10 melanoma cells, with cell survival rates of 72.4%, 58.2%, and 43.6% at 24, 48, and 72 h of incubation, respectively, at a concentration of 100 microM. Molecular docking studies further revealed multiple binding interactions between Res and the coordination polymer, suggesting a promising therapeutic strategy for melanoma treatment by integrating advanced materials with bioactive compounds.
abstract_zh: 黑色素瘤是一种高度侵袭性的癌症，与升高的肿瘤突变负荷（TMB）和活跃的肿瘤微环境（TME）密切相关。黑色素合成是黑色素瘤进展的关键特征，主要由酪氨酸酶（TYR）调控，该酶是受小眼畸形相关转录因子（MITF）控制的限速酶。白藜芦醇（Res）是一种天然多酚，以其抗氧化和抗癌特性著称，但面临溶解度差、生物利用度低和代谢迅速等局限性。为克服这些挑战，合成了一种三维Co(II)配位聚合物[Co(bpdado)(bpe)(H(2)O)(2)].2DMF.2 H(2)On (1)，并将其掺入复合材料1@CP1中，用于Res递送（1@CP1@Res）。该系统表现出增强的溶解度、pH敏感释放和改善的生物活性。荧光测定显示，在存在Cu(2)(+)离子时发生显著猝灭，表明1@CP1@Res对金属离子相互作用具有高灵敏度。pH响应性药物释放特性通过体外研究得到证实，显示在较低pH值下释放加速，模拟酸性肿瘤微环境。细胞活力测定显示，1@CP1@Res显著抑制小鼠B16-F10黑色素瘤细胞的增殖，在100微摩尔浓度下，孵育24、48和72小时的细胞存活率分别为72.4%、58.2%和43.6%。分子对接研究进一步揭示了Res与配位聚合物之间的多种结合相互作用，表明通过将先进材料与生物活性化合物整合，为黑色素瘤治疗提供了一种有前景的治疗策略。
